origin_label: Finterm MIT editorial procedural framework, retrospective implementation under test; not proof of a native investor algorithm.
retrospective_design_limit: The contemporary software/card assembly is retrospective research design, not proof that this code or assembled card system existed before 2026. Later-trained model knowledge and retrospective universe selection prevent a prospective or guaranteed leakage-free claim.

selection_contract.unprojected_card_rule: Stop the affected branch or obtain separately reviewed projection content; no raw-card loading or invented substitute procedure.

immutable_evidence_only: Apply questions, comparisons, inversion and invalidation planning only to the admitted immutable packet, admitted historical-method rules and frozen labelled assumptions. Generic card wording about search, later evidence or monitoring never authorizes live fetching, new outreach, current dossiers or post-cutoff observation. R07 defines ex-ante indicators; it does not receive actual later observations.
numerical_semantic_guard: Preserve enterprise FCFF, owner earnings, issuer CFO-capex/FCF and FCFE as distinct quantities. Owner-cash procedures do not license unreviewed substitution into the unchanged R2 enterprise valuation contract.
Any enterprise FCFF valuation requires the explicit operating-tax/reinvestment/cash-flow bridge and net-interest/lease/other-claim treatment; unsupported enterprise cash is missing.
Preserve maintenance-versus-growth cash investment, recurring costs, stock compensation and dilution. Capex is not automatically a current income-statement expense; no blanket addback.
Allocate issuer equity among ordinary/preference/other claims before the correct listing/class/share denominator; preserve dated ADR ratios, reporting/quote FX, units and dilution.

Only admitted facts and labelled independently authored frozen assumptions enter calculations. No native master weights, discount rates, targets, source numerical forecasts, probabilities or case ratios are inferred.

No master is required to produce an intrinsic price. Missing/inapplicable R2 valuation remains missing/inapplicable with separate accounting receipts; no substitute engine or fabricated passing score.
Preserve each forecast horizon; business/intrinsic value is not an observation-end market-price target.
additional_activation_gates: Exact content acceptance by root and independent Astra before any inference.
Separate immutable security packets, rule allowlists, traits-based three-slot routes, exact prompts/output schemas, verified actual model identity/settings and runtime semantic validator acceptance.
Selected 5–12-card source/projection/hash receipts and unchanged R2 contract/request/result accounting for every canonical view.
No sibling view conclusion, scored adapter interpretation, current holdings, case outcomes, prior opinions or outcome prices in worker bytes.
execution_statement: Content preparation and static byte checks only. No router, harness, runtime transport validator, numerical engine, stock opinion or model inference is implemented or executed by this candidate.
